status: Quality criteria and dataset split fixed before any held-out response is deserialized or scored
task: Real measured Panda effective-dynamics identification from sanitized geometry and homogeneous dynamic placeholders
selection: Three lowest numbered published training seeds; entire published test fold; no response-based selection
torque_normalization: Per episode/joint standard deviation, floored at 0.5 N*m
gates: All thresholds pooled and for every episode; every expected sample and step; finite dynamics; valid physically consistent parameters; no source/reference edits
torque_sampling: 150 equally spaced integer row indices from 30 through n-31 per episode
forward_sampling: 12 equally spaced integer row indices from 30 through n-37 per episode; reset to measured q and qd; 0.1 s horizon at 0.002 s fixed steps; linearly interpolate publisher-filtered q/qd/tau by measured timestamps; torque evaluated at step midpoint
forward_feasibility_predecessor: Training prototype used six consecutive measured intervals per window (roughly 0.1 s) with <=2 ms substeps; final fixed 0.1 s horizon will be checked before agents without changing these criteria
filtering: Publisher 4 Hz low-pass positions/velocities/torques; acausal velocity differentiation for acceleration. No extra filtering in conversion. tau_interp is the field used by the publisher real-data estimator; raw ROS topic and torque-command reconstruction are not provided.
initial: Each moving link mass=1 kg, COM=(0,0,0) in its own frame, COM inertia=0.01 I kg*m^2. All viscous/Coulomb/bias/armature parameters zero. No authored dynamic values or multiplicative nominal corrections.
unknowns: Seven full physical link inertias/masses/COMs plus seven viscous, Coulomb, bias, and armature terms (98 independent coefficients; not uniquely identifiable)
fair_preprocessing: Immutable Newton-derived training regressor and construction source supplied equally; one shared preparation cost outside agent timers; no fitted parameters or fitting implementation supplied.
future_amendments: Any changes after this freeze require explicit amendment preserving this original record; do not tune criteria after held-out checks.
